environment.description: Same Quarkus 3.2 native function deployed on AWS Lambda, fronted by an Application Load Balancer with a listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS verification. The ALB trust store (com.amazonaws.elasticloadbalancing.TrustStore) references an internal CA bundle (arn:aws:acm-pca:us-east-1:111222333444:certificate-authority/ca-abc123) and the listener attribute 'routing.http.x_amzn_mtls_clientcert_validation' is set to 'verify'. Connections without a valid client certificate signed by the internal PCA are terminated at the ALB with a 400 response before reaching the Lambda function. The JWKS endpoint is served on a separate internal-only VPC endpoint not accessible from the public internet. Note: the ALB does NOT inspect JWT content or enforce any application-layer token validation — it only enforces transport-layer client identity via the X.509 certificate chain validation against the private CA.

config.network: ALB in private subnet, no public API Gateway
